- C++ observer, build definition, geometry, physics steering and statistics remain unchanged.
- Independently verified both geometries’ serial24/MT24 artifact hashes, source bindings and complete map records. All four runs and both paired-control summaries pass.

Reusing these controls after a map-guard-only correction is valid. Preserve their original receipts and source revisions; add a separate verification record binding the new guard revision to the existing receipt, readback and map hashes. Production should use the corrected checkpoint.
